lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits. The blobs are organized into approximately 10 visible vertical columns, with 4 to 6 blobs per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured matrix where the highest-luminance nodes are positioned at the grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient: a light-colored upper edge transitioning to a high-contrast shadow region below, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin; however, due to pixel blurring and water-column distortion, the precise spatial distribution is less defined than the lateral flank clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a high-density, stochastic distribution of smaller pixel clusters, contrasting with the organized grid-like patterning of the mid-flank.
